comment: Open source, read at commit 4a148ff, whose plugin.json is byte-identical to the installed 2.0.1 build; that is the last commit on the repository and the only one carrying version 2.0.1. The module has no parameters, no inputs, no outputs and no lights, and its process() body is empty, so nothing here can be tagged. The text field in the menu takes the keyboard for as long as the menu is open: EventParamField::step calls setSelectedWidget on itself every frame. Enter commits; dismissing the menu any other way leaves the old text. There is no undo entry for a text change, since the module writes the string directly rather than through a history action. The typeface is Mad Midnight Marker by Darrell Flood, shipped in res/. The README's two screenshots are current.
